mechanics.claim: The armor reduction is applied after the damage lands, so the initial hit does not benefit from the reduced armor.

mechanics.claim: Enemies already hit by this cast cannot be hit or damaged again by the same cast.
mechanics.quote: Enemies already hit by ''Dragon Strike'' cannot be affected more than once.

mechanics.claim: If the lance connects with a deployed Demacian Standard, Jarvan IV dashes to its location, knocking up nearby enemies (a separate effect from the initial hit damage).
mechanics.quote: If the lance connects with a deployed ''{{ai|Demacian Standard|Jarvan IV}}'', '''Jarvan IV''' {{tip|dashes}} to its location, {{tip|airborne|knocking up}} nearby enemies around him and along his path

mechanics.claim: Jarvan IV can cast any of his abilities during the dash.
